text_block_list.text:
—Phew.
I managed to take 1st place safely~

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, it is nothing extraordinary.
All results are merely the culmination of everyday effort.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So let's not get complacent with the results,
and keep up our training~.

Please continue to accompany me as we aim for the summit~

As the saying goes, "Tighten your helmet strings after a victory."
